description: A React functional component named ScoreGauge that renders a circular score indicator with a conic-gradient. The component displays a score (default 0) visually as a part of a circle, with styling to create a gauge-like appearance, and includes a label beneath the gauge.

methods.name: ScoreGauge({ score = 0, label = 'ATS Score' })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a circular score indicator with customizable score and label.
